name: Werkzeug debugger remote code execution (CVE-2024-34069)
description: The interactive debugger in Werkzeug can be tricked into executing code via crafted requests when exposed.
rationale: Debug interfaces exposed in production violate NIST CM-7 (least functionality) and AC-6 (least privilege). PCI DSS 2.2.4 requires removal of unnecessary functionality. Fixing the library closes the attack path; disabling the debugger in production is the policy control.
